title: Chapter 391
content:
Chapter 391

And just when the Ming Dynasty and the Huangshan Demon King actively promoted the establishment of a peace treaty, dividing their respective territories. Zhong Yu, who was in Hecheng County at the rear, quietly watching the changing situation, also started his actions.

"it's time!"

After such a long period of observation, Zhong Yu has already understood the weakness of the Ming Dynasty and his current situation.

Although the entire Ming Dynasty is quite powerful, there are 20 powerhouses above the sixth rank in the country, but most of them are stationed in various places, guarding against the aggression of other countries, and they cannot be deployed at all.

Now that there is war again, the powerful country in the north, Dajinjin, has mobilized troops to invade the Ming Dynasty southward, which makes the stormy Ming Dynasty even worse, and it is difficult to deal with it.

Up to now, even the two little demon kings can't deal with it, they can only rely on the humiliation to reach a contract, and sell the territory of the human race since ancient times behind their backs.

The weakness of the Ming Dynasty can be seen from this.

Now Dongjiang Province in the easternmost part of the Ming Dynasty, which is the province where Zhong Yu is located, is surrounded by thousands of miles of mountains and forests in the east, which is a natural barrier, in which wild beasts are rampant and demons are everywhere, ordinary people can't get over it, and the army can't do it unless they are powerful master.

With this barrier, it is impossible for enemies farther away in the forest to come and attack.

As for the monster clan in the mountains and forests, after these several wars, most of their strength has been lost, leaving only the 30,000 remaining monster soldiers gathered under the Huangshan Demon King in Dongjiang Province. Although their strength is strong, they are not much stronger. .

And there are only 20,000 Ming troops left in Dongjiang Province, and it is a bit difficult to defend, let alone attack.

Under such circumstances, after such a long period of observation and preparation, Zhong Yu has already mobilized a group of third-tier legions with a population of about 100,000 through his small world, plus his remaining 10,000 fourth-tier legions. Legion, enough to sweep the entire Dongjiang Province.

And after flattening Dongjiang Province, it is not impossible to take advantage of the trend to invade other surrounding provinces.

After all, judging from the current situation of the Ming Dynasty, it is completely a doomsday scene, unable to cope with its own attack at all.

As long as Zhong Yu doesn't die, he will attack the imperial capital of the Ming Dynasty and try to destroy it. Lead out the seventh-order and even the eighth-order immortal gods behind the Ming Dynasty to make a move.

Just occupying three or four provinces of the Ming Dynasty, although it will still attract the hatred of the Ming Dynasty, but the intensity will definitely be much smaller, at least with Zhong Yu's strength, he can deal with it.

As for the remaining two sixth-level demon kings, with the invincible strength of the same level, it should not be too easy to wipe them out.

Time passed quickly, and in the process, all preparations quickly became sufficient. An extraordinary army of 110,000 quickly assembled, and countless supplies piled up like mountains. With the ability to travel through small worlds, it has now Having developed hundreds of worlds, such mere troops and supplies are naturally nothing to worry about.

Hecheng County, the entire county is still in panic as before, and most of the pedestrians coming and going have disappeared. They all hide in their homes and tremble, welcoming the fate of death.

Since the imperial court and the Yaozu reached a contract, the news that their area was divided into the Yaozu's territory also spread.

As soon as the news spread, the entire county fell into panic, and countless people became completely desperate, fearful and hated.

The fate of death is inevitable. Under the package of the 30,000 demon army, there are still two demon kings. A small county like them can't stop them, and their complete demise will happen sooner or later.

Many people wanted to run away, especially those big families, each of whom raised dozens or hundreds of servants, who were physically strong and had a certain ability to protect themselves.

It's just that when they took all their belongings and planned to go all the way west from the county seat in an attempt to escape to the area controlled by the imperial court, a cruel reality hit them in the head.

These teams hadn't been out of the city for long before they were eaten up by a small group of monsters who had scattered around the county, and their wealth and lives were completely thrown outside the city.

But those lucky ones who survived fled to the city, and after the news spread, all the people who still hoped to escape gave up the idea of fleeing and began to wait in the city to die.

The county seat also fell into complete chaos at this moment.

Zhong Yu was walking on the street, and around him, he could see strong men with crazy looks, kicking open one door after another, rushing in, and then there were several sounds Screaming and exclaiming, the crime broke out at this moment.

This kind of thing can be seen everywhere in the entire county. After there is no way out, the destructive power of the desperate people and the ugliness of human nature are vividly revealed before his eyes.

There are even a few things that don't open their eyes. Seeing Zhong Yu dressed in luxury and walking alone on the road, they moved their minds that shouldn't be moved, and wanted to come up and make a fortune.

But Zhong Yu just glanced at them, and then these rogues became hot all over, turning into streams of magma and turning into ashes.

This method strongly confirmed that the surroundings were also thinking about it, but they were quite cautious, and planned to observe other people, so that they would never dare to have bad thoughts again.

Walking forward without haste, along the only avenue in the county, and also the only bustling street, towards the county government in the center of the city.

As for all the ugliness that was happening along the way, he was in no mood to stop it.

In any case, he has traveled through several worlds, and in each world, he is the ruler of one force, controlling the lives and deaths of countless people.

For the lives of some civilians in the district, it has long been not as important as it was at the beginning.

Even Zhong Yu himself is a butcher whose hands are stained with blood and who has destroyed countless lives. To him, these things that are happening before him are nothing more than pediatrics.

He has seen many more tragic distortions of human nature, and even directed many of them himself.

Although the small county town is not big, it is also not small. A main road is only a few hundred meters, which is not too long, and it will be finished soon.

Although the county government at this time is still magnificent and full of majesty, it lacks that spirit and is full of twilight instead.

There were four arresters standing in front of the county yamen. All of them were full of vigor and blood, their eyes were bright, and their bodies were muscular. It seemed that they were not weak and had accomplished cultivation.

In fact, that was exactly the case. Each of these four arresters was a warrior at the peak of Tier 3, who was only one step away from entering Tier 4. For ordinary people, it might not be impossible to be called a strong man.

Zhong Yu was standing on the square in front of the yamen. The place where the county lords usually used to proclaim the law and spread enlightenment was empty. The square in Nuoda was extremely empty, and with the gusts of autumn wind blowing, it was rather bleak. .

"arrive!"

Zhong Yu murmured something, and then walked straight towards the main gate of the county government that was guarded by four policemen.
